item.title: Roku Pro Series OLED TV Review: Budget Luxury at $1,000
item.description: Roku’s first OLED TV, the Pro Series, delivers deep blacks, vivid colors and Roku’s easy UI at a $1,000 entry price, disrupting the budget TV segment.
